title: Bounty Night at FOSS Lab
briefing: 11:40 PM, FOSS Lab, Model Engineering College. Sponsor bounty payouts (₹15,000 total) go out tomorrow morning, and someone just wiped the top three spots on the contribution leaderboard, reassigning 42 merged PRs to an empty account named 'dev_null_99'. No external logins hit the box. Four people were in the lab tonight: Benito Mathew, Josh Philip, Dan Antony, and Assaf. Figure out who edited the database and prove it before morning.

foss_lab.description: Long table tangled with extension cords and half-empty paper chaya cups. The shared lab ThinkPad running Ubuntu 24.04 is awake on the center desk with a rattling fan and an active tmux session.

corner_table.description: A whiteboard covered in sponsor payout math and crossed-out PR counts. Someone's open notebook, a crumpled UPI receipt from the gate stall, and a charger cable sit next to a sticky note.

benito.name: Benito Mathew
benito.alibi: merged the final prs around 10:30, pushed tags, and walked down to the gate with the first-years for puffs and sulaimani. check my gpay if you want, i wasn't even upstairs.
benito.follow_up: look, okay—i squash-merged two of my own readme typo fixes at 10:28 so josh wouldn't pass me by 10 points. dumb move, yeah, i'll drop those points. but i didn't touch the sqlite db.

evidence_reactions.gpay_receipt: yeah that's mine, 11:21 at kunjikka's stall. five of us were standing right there.
evidence_reactions.sqlite_history: why would i zero out my own handle? i was literally #1 before that ran.

josh.name: Josh Philip
josh.alibi: i was at the corner table updating the sponsor notion doc till 11:30. went to wash my face for like five minutes around 11:15, left my laptop open, that's it.
josh.follow_up: fine, i ran a dry-run on tally.py at 11:05 because benito's score jumped right before freeze and i wanted to check the diff. i forgot to close the ssh pane when i stepped out.

evidence_reactions.tmux_pane: that's my dry-run from 11:05. i didn't run any sql update—someone must have used my open terminal while i was in the washroom.

dan.name: Dan Antony
dan.alibi: honestly tally.py has been flaky all week. probably a race condition when the 11:30 cron job hit sqlite while github webhooks were firing. i was just debugging my branch.
dan.follow_up: my pr failed ci at 11:10 so i was already out of the top three anyway. why would i bother messing with the leaderboard?

evidence_reactions.cron_log: okay so cron just read what was already in the db. still doesn't mean it was me.
evidence_reactions.hotspot_dhcp: lots of people use nothing phones on campus, man.
evidence_reactions.git_reflog: ...wait. where did you pull that reflog from? i amended that commit.

assaf.name: Assaf
assaf.alibi: i was near the server rack flashing an sd card for tomorrow's workshop demo. left right after the 11:30 sync finished.
assaf.follow_up: yes, i have root keys to bounty-box and i manage the sponsor upi pool, but i don't even have a contributor profile on the leaderboard.

evidence_reactions.hotspot_dhcp: yeah i use a nothing phone 2a, and my hotspot stays on auto-share for the pis. anyone on the lab machine could've clicked connect.
evidence_reactions.cron_log: that's the standard cron job i set up last week—it just mirrors whatever is in sqlite.
evidence_reactions.auth_log: that 23:04 ssh login is from the lab thinkpad's ip, not my laptop.

solution.closing_summary: Case closed. Dan Antony saw his final PR fail CI at 11:10 PM, knocking him out of the ₹5,000 third-place bounty. While Josh Philip stepped away from his open SSH session on the lab ThinkPad at 11:19 PM, Dan tethered the box to Assaf's auto-sharing Nothing Phone hotspot, registered 'dev_null_99' using the same throwaway Gmail left in his local git reflog, and manually ran the SQL UPDATE at 11:22 PM—hoping to claim the burner account anonymously in the morning.
